summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K and next-day disclosure return under Hong Kong listing rules, reporting a share repurchase on May 8, 2026. The issuer bought back 540,000 ADS-equivalent WVR ordinary shares on the Nasdaq at US$2.465/share, representing 0.0569% of existing issued shares, and held them as treasury shares. The repurchase was authorized by the board and complies with applicable rules. This is an open-market buyback returning capital to shareholders, not a tender offer. Watch for continued buyback activity and potential impact on ADS liquidity and overhang.
